subject: Vendor enrollment: vendor record creation, PO header requirements, EDI / portal credentials
messages:
From: APTeam@parallax.ai
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Parallax vendor enrollment request

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the quick intro to Redwood Inference. We need to create a vendor record for Redwood in our AP system before we can issue POs and process invoices. To speed the activation please return the completed enrollment packet attached and the items below: 

- Legal entity name and DBA (if any)
- Tax ID / VAT number (W-9 or W-8-BEN if applicable)
- Remittance address for invoices
- Preferred payment method: ACH (please confirm bank routing & account; send a voided check or bank letter), or wire
- Invoice requirements: where to put PO number (PDF header + invoice field), mandatory line-item fields, and whether tax is applied per line in your invoices
- File transport: EDI (X12)/AS2 or SFTP dropbox. If EDI, please provide test cert and EDI partner endpoint. If SFTP, provide user + public key that we can register
- Early payment / dynamic discount opt-in form (if you want early pay programs)

We attached Parallax-Vendor-Enrollment-Form.pdf. Target to complete by 07/06 for the 07/10 PO planned. If you have a single contact for onboarding call, suggest times tomorrow 10–11am PT.

Regards,
Parallax AP Team
APTeam@parallax.ai

Hi Parallax AP,

Thanks — looping in Laura (Finance Ops) and Ben (Partner Ops) to gather. We'll complete the form and return with a masked bank document and sample invoice. Quick Q for your intake: do you require the PO number to be present in the PDF file name, or is it sufficient to have the PO in the invoice header and the EDI reference? Also, is there a required invoice line-item SKU format (we generally include product name, description, qty, unit price, tax code) — if you can paste an example it will help.

We can do a 30 minute onboarding call at 10:30am PT tomorrow — will confirm.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Head of Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference

Aditya / Ben,

Attached is our registration packet for vendor upload. I included the minimal set Parallax asked for and a couple optional notes:

- Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Remittance address: 1209 Market St, Suite 420, San Francisco, CA 94103
- Federal Tax ID: XX-XXXXXXX (W9 attached as PDF, last four masked on this thread)
- EU VAT (if Parallax EU entity needs it): GB999999973 (please let me know which legal entity in your system this is linked to)
- Bank details: Bank of Redwood — Account XXXXX1234, Routing 0XXXXXX (we will send a bank letter via secure portal; do not store raw account numbers in email).
- Preferred payment: ACH (Net 30) by default; we will evaluate early-pay offers.

PO / invoice formatting notes:
- Mandatory: PO number in invoice header (Invoice: field) and in the PDF filename as PO{PO#}_Invoice_{Invoice#}.pdf when submitting via portal.
- Line items: include a SKU column, description, quantity, unit price; tax must be flagged at line level with tax code (e.g. TAX-N/A, TAX-UST, TAX-EU).
- For EDI: we can support 810, and will include the PO number in the REF segment (REF*PO*{PO#}).

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Registration_Packet.zip (includes Redwood_W9.pdf and a sample Invoice_20280701_PO12345.pdf)

I'll upload the bank letter to the portal if you confirm the secure upload link; otherwise we'll route via DocuSign for tokenization.

Laura
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: APTeam@parallax.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: vendor-portal-support@parallax.ai
Date: 2028-07-04T12:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Parallax vendor enrollment request — follow ups

Hi Laura / Aditya,

Thanks for the packet — that looks good. A couple follow-ups before we provision: 

1) Transport: Parallax prefers EDI (810) for recurring supplier invoices; if you cannot EDI, SFTP drop is acceptable. If EDI, please send AS2 cert and we will register you. If SFTP, please provide an SSH public key and username.
2) Bank tokenization: we accept tokenized bank credentials via DocuSign banking form. If you prefer, we can register your account under vendor token ID V-0004521 and you can upload a bank letter to our secure portal (https://parallax-pportal.example.com/upload/V-0004521).
3) Invoice test: please upload one sample invoice (the PDF attached in your packet is fine) and one EDI 810 test file or a CSV sample to the portal by 2028-07-06 for a test cycle on 07/08.
4) Early pay: early payment programs are managed by Parallax Treasury; enrollment is a separate opt-in. If you want early-pay, we'll send the contract addendum; typical rates are 1.5%/10 or 0.5%/5 depending on volume.

I'll open the vendor record once we receive the certs and sample invoice. If you prefer, we can provision a sandbox EDI endpoint for testing.

– Parallax AP

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-04T13:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Parallax vendor enrollment request — internal ops note

Team — quick ops notes before we send credentials: 

- Do not send full bank account numbers over email. Use the DocuSign banking form link Parallax provided or upload the bank letter to the secure portal. I'll coordinate with Security to ensure we use tokenization (V-0004521) once Parallax creates the vendor id.
- For EDI: our integrations team can generate an AS2 cert by EOD. Laura, can you confirm whether we should provide an 810 (invoicing) only endpoint or do we need to support 850/855? Parallax only requested 810 but some partners expect the full PO-ACK loop.
- Early-pay: if we enroll, require legal to review addendum; notify Sales for fee allocation.

I'll plan to join the onboarding call.

Ben
Partner Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
